_meta.description: Expected Robinhood Chain testnet V4 deployment used by T024 as the baseline for the capability probe. The chain_id comes from the project owner's stated value (46630); the PoolManager and StateView addresses come from the project's CREATE2 derivation (same addresses as mainnet by design — see ADR-005 §'V1 admits one chain' and the Uniswap V4 CREATE2 deployment). The bytecode hashes are pinned from the on-chain probe report under docs/implement/protocol-artifacts/chain-capability-report-robinhood-testnet.json; subsequent probes must match or fail closed with a 'bytecode_drift' reason.
_meta.source_chain_id: owner-confirmed; verified by the on-chain probe at 2026-09-16
_meta.source_pool_manager: project documentation; CREATE2 deployment produces the same address as mainnet by design
_meta.license: Documentation references are public; deployment addresses are public facts on the respective chains.

_verification_notes: Re-run probe_chain_capability(adapter, ExpectedDeployment(...)) against the two configured endpoints (alchemy-testnet from env ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_RPC_URL and robinhood-official-testnet at https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com) and commit the resulting ChainCapabilityReport under docs/implement/protocol-artifacts/chain-capability-report-robinhood-testnet.json.
pool_manager_code_hash and state_view_code_hash were populated from the report's pool_manager.<endpoint>.code_hash and state_view.<endpoint>.code_hash fields after every endpoint agreed on the value.
All endpoints must agree on chain_id, PoolManager bytecode hash, and StateView bytecode hash before this artifact can be marked 'verified'.
If any endpoint reports a different chain_id or bytecode hash, the report fails and the deployment is rejected (T024 acceptance).
Bytecode drift vs the reference commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba fails the report with a 'bytecode_drift' reason; the probe does NOT fall back to the mainnet code hash.
